index.consent.title: Your rights and our commitment
index.consent.who_we_are_title: Who we are and what we do
index.consent.who_we_are_text: IDENTIFLY is a digital contact card application. Your personal data is stored exclusively on your device via localStorage. We never send, sell or transfer it to third parties under any circumstances.
index.consent.legal_basis_text: The processing of your data is based on your explicit consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR). You have the right to withdraw this consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal. In accordance with Art. 7 GDPR, this consent is freely given, specific, informed and unambiguous.
index.consent.rights_text:
Art. 15 — Access: You can view all your data at any time from the settings screen.

Art. 16 — Rectification: You can modify your data whenever you want.

Art. 17 — Erasure ("right to be forgotten"): You can delete all your data by clearing your browser data or uninstalling the app.

Art. 18 — Restriction: You can block which data is included in your QR using the permission toggles.

Art. 20 — Portability: Your data lives on your device and is exportable in standard vCard format through the QR.

Art. 21 — Objection: You can object to the use of any piece of data by disabling its permission individually.

Art. 22 — Automated decisions: IDENTIFLY does not make automated decisions about you or carry out profiling.
index.consent.security_text:
Your access password is designed with certifiable mathematical security criteria:

IDENTIFLY password (minimum 8 characters: letters, numbers and symbols)
The longer and more varied your password, the greater the protection. Each additional character exponentially multiplies the number of possible combinations, making the password practically impossible to break by brute force.

Comparison with a 4-digit numeric PIN:
— 4-digit numeric PIN: 10,000 combinations → cracked in 10 seconds at 1,000 attempts/sec.
— IDENTIFLY password: astronomically higher combinations → radically superior protection.

This level meets and exceeds the appropriate technical measures required under Art. 32 GDPR. No data is transmitted to external servers — your password never leaves your device.
index.consent.lockout_title: Lockout and recovery protocol — GDPR Art. 32
index.consent.lockout_text: For your security, after 3 failed access attempts your account is locked for 30 minutes. IDENTIFLY has a 3-phase recovery process: Phase 1 — a 6-digit backup code sent automatically when you register, which you must keep permanently in your email. Phase 2 — a temporary code sent to your email at the time of recovery. Phase 3 — creating a new master password. If you don't keep your backup code, the only option available is a full data wipe and a new registration from scratch. IDENTIFLY cannot recover your account without this code — keeping it safe is your responsibility.
index.consent.twofa_text:
IDENTIFLY offers optional two-factor authentication that adds a mathematically verifiable second layer of security:

Factor 1 — Password (something you know)
689 billion combinations → 21,000 years to crack.

Factor 2A — TOTP (something you have)
A 6-digit code that changes every 30 seconds. An attacker would need to know your password AND have your phone within that exact 30-second window. Probability of a successful brute-force attack: 1 in 10⁶ every 30 seconds = practically impossible.

Factor 2B — Biometric (something you are)
Face ID / fingerprint via WebAuthn/FIDO2. The standard used by banks, governments and defense services. Apple's Face ID false acceptance rate is 1 in 1,000,000 (0.0001%).

With all three factors combined:
Password × TOTP × Biometric = probability of unauthorized access ≈ 1 in 689 quadrillion

This level of protection exceeds the security requirements of GDPR Art. 32 for special category personal data and is equivalent to NIST SP 800-63B Authenticator Assurance Level 3 (AAL3), the highest level defined by the US National Institute of Standards and Technology.
index.consent.deletion_title: Right to be forgotten and voluntary deletion — GDPR Art. 17
index.consent.deletion_text:
In accordance with GDPR Art. 17, you have the right to erasure of all your personal data at any time, without needing to justify it.

IDENTIFLY provides a red voluntary deletion button accessible from the settings screen that immediately and irreversibly removes:

— Your full profile (name, phone, email, address, social links)
— Your access password.
— Your 2FA settings (TOTP and biometric)
— Your custom QR design.
— All your permissions and preferences.

Since all data lives exclusively on your device, deletion is instant and total. There is no copy on any external server.
index.consent.duties_text:
PIN confidentiality: Your access PIN is personal and non-transferable. You must not share it with anyone, not family, not friends, not any third party under any circumstances.

Device custody: You are responsible for not leaving your device unlocked with IDENTIFLY open in front of third parties. You must not lend your phone with the app active.

Personal use: IDENTIFLY is designed for the personal, exclusive use of the account holder. Use by anyone other than the account holder is not permitted.

Accuracy of data: The information you enter must be truthful. Entering data belonging to third parties without their explicit consent is not permitted.

Lawful use: Using IDENTIFLY for illegal or fraudulent activities, or activities that infringe on the rights of others, is prohibited.
index.consent.prohibitions_text:
The following is strictly prohibited:

— Attempting to bypass, hack or manipulate the app's PIN system.

— Using the app to impersonate another person.

— Sharing or publishing screenshots of another user's QR without their consent.

— Attempting to access other users' data by any means.

— Modifying, decompiling or reverse-engineering the app's code.

— Using the app on compromised devices (jailbroken/rooted) that could expose your data.
index.consent.liability_text:
IDENTIFLY is provided "as is", without guarantees of continuous availability. We are not responsible for:

— Data loss due to clearing browser or device data.

— Unauthorized access resulting from the user having shared their PIN.

— Damages resulting from incorrect or careless use of the app.

The user assumes full responsibility for their use of the app and the data they choose to share via the QR.
index.consent.jurisdiction_text:
This app is governed by applicable Spanish and European law, including:

— GDPR (EU) 2016/679 — General Data Protection Regulation.

— LOPD-GDD (Organic Law 3/2018) — Spanish Data Protection and Digital Rights Guarantee Act.

— LSSI-CE — Spanish Information Society Services Act.

— Spanish Criminal Code — Arts. 197-201 on offenses against privacy and the secrecy of communications.
